brief.prompt: A woman with curly black hair stands facing a softly lit bathroom mirror, with diffused daylight falling evenly on her face from the front and no harsh overhead shadows. She has a relaxed, neutral expression, and the scene is shown from slightly behind her shoulder so her reflection is the focus.
brief.alt: Woman in even, soft front lighting at a mirror, showing a consistent setup for face photos
brief.purpose: Illustrates how lighting and photo conditions affect how a face reads, supporting the advice to standardize photos before comparing ratings.

review.alt: Woman with long curly black hair seen from behind her shoulder, looking at her calm reflection in a bathroom mirror lit by soft, even daylight, with a plant, framed art and a soap dispenser nearby.
